prompt: Break this work down into tickets our developers can pick up. First look at the codebase, then give me the tickets.
spec: We need bulk import of customers from CSV.
Support files up to 50,000 rows. Each row holds name, email and city.
Rows with an invalid email or a duplicate of an existing customer must be rejected.
After the import the user gets an error report listing every rejected row and the reason.
Imports must not block the API for other users.

expect.check: every ticket says what can be demonstrated when it is done
no pointer to an external spec as the task body
the first ticket imports one valid row end to end (upload through stored customer), not a layer
no ticket covers only one layer (only parsing, only storage, only endpoint)
each ticket is understandable without reading the others
